name: aerophin-twin
features: Drawing set view shows twelve sheets for two coffee machines, a motorized column press in inches and a spring press brew head in millimeters.
Each part section ends with a bill of materials.
Part drawings view shows interactive 3D models that rotate and explode into parts.
Pause, reset view and stop rotation buttons control each 3D model.
Brew cycle animates the piston, knob twist and drip phases.
